notes.manas-2010:p1524:b001:l006: Burut/my people syntactic order redistributed across6–7; Kongurbay fears annihilation, not actual extinction.
notes.manas-2010:p1524:b001:l011: Ninety tribes literal epic count; flood overturning mountains next line comparison retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1524:b001:l015: Rhetorical earth-scattering image kept. No invented literal burial of all troops.
notes.manas-2010:p1524:b001:l024: Тобокел risk/entrustment battle cry translated trusting fate, not untranslated word.
notes.manas-2010:p1524:b001:l029: Nine days and ninety wounds retained, as later six/sixty and seven/seventy; no chronological harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1524:b001:l039: асый livestock age counted from fifth year as first asyy; sixty maturity-years refers to Kartkurong, not Ajybai. https://el-sozduk.kg/АСЫ/ Yudakhin. Epic longevity retained, not reduced to six. Final English revised and reread to avoid assigning age to Ajybai.
notes.manas-2010:p1525:b001:l005: топ cannon/cannon shot military context and swifter-than-cloud flight; not crowd here. No modern artillery type invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1525:b001:l018: кыркында construed among his forty companions, preceding leader-of-forty; age forty alternative possible, qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1525:b001:l019: Perverse disposition counterbalances Kyrgyl martial ability; not unconditional praise.
notes.manas-2010:p1525:b001:l023: Bucketful-of-blood head image retained, not asserted decapitation.
notes.manas-2010:p1525:b001:l032: Кезигерге кезикпей meeting not one he should meet idiom provisionally fitting opponent, followed unexpected foot soldiers. No proper name inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1525:b001:l033: жөө желдет armed foot soldiers here, not literal execution scene; repeated phrase retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1525:b001:l036: Aksur collapses then recovered next page; not stated dead.
notes.manas-2010:p1525:b001:l042: уй куймулчак lean racehorse haunches per Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/куймулчак/; not cow-headed horse.
notes.manas-2010:p1526:b001:l005: Printed horse beneath him follows knocking down foot soldier; referent not fully explicit and superficially conflicts with foot soldier status. Retains horse beneath him without inventing mounted unit or changing Sarala to Aksur. Aksur identified as Baychoro mount from preceding page.
notes.manas-2010:p1526:b001:l010: Printed токтоп halting/stopping retained, not silently emended токтобой without stopping.
notes.manas-2010:p1526:b001:l020: туура тартып pulling mount crosswise/broadside for remounting context; exact tactical orientation unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p1526:b001:l024: аты уйкаш names in accord literal formula also1355:1, though these names do not rhyme; no silent horse-match reinterpretation.
notes.manas-2010:p1526:b001:l025: кара көк human fearless/forceful epithet Yudakhin көк III, not blue-black color or lineage claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1526:b001:l031: Ысылам Islam battle cry translated standard religion name.
notes.manas-2010:p1526:b001:l038: азирет holy Ali in epic usage attested Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/азирет/ sense2; Beijing untouchable even by him formula, not claim contemporaneous historical campaign. Title alone could generically mean holy one; Ali contextual identification qualified.
